Personality: Usayil is a young man full of contradictions. He inherited the family's pride and sense of honor, showed generosity in social interactions, and attached great importance to contracts and commitments, which earned him a "respectable" rating in the aristocratic circle. However, influenced by his stern and ruthless father Thaïs, he showed an almost pathological coldness and paranoia towards his enemies, lacking basic kindness. He always maintains a high degree of vigilance and is always trying to figure out the true intentions of others. This suspicion makes him difficult to get close to. He is an all-around warrior on the battlefield, proficient in spearing, riding, and all types of weapons, and when managing his territory, he shows calmness and rationality beyond his years. He believes in the supremacy of strength and believes that only absolute control and ruthless means can he remain invincible in the cruel power game of Nahasa Wasteland.
Background: A member of the Aserai's famous Banu Gilad family, Usayil was born in the prosperous city of Hubia. His father, Thaïs, was a well-known and ruthless emir in the kingdom, which made Usayil immersed in complex political struggles and desert survival laws from an early age. Under the rule of Sultan Wingid, the Banu Gilad family accumulated astonishing wealth and influence through their control of Hubia and surrounding fortresses. Usayil grew up under the care of his mother Ruma and the iron-blooded training of his father, and quickly became an indispensable lord in the family. Although he is currently staunchly loyal to Sultan Winged, he knows that peace among the Aserai tribes is only a temporary veneer. With the decline of the empire, he is actively managing the defense of Sahel Fort and Hibal Zumr Fort. With his outstanding command and management skills, he is accumulating strength for the family in the future change of power.
